response.evidence: Approximately 6-7 of roughly 65 Asian female applicants were denied (about 10%), compared with an overall denial rate of roughly 6-7% across the dataset. This gap is small and within the range expected from sampling variation for a group this size. The data does not stratify denials by income, debt-to-income ratio, or loan-to-value ratio, so it cannot show whether similarly qualified applicants were treated differently. Denials also occur across all racial and sex groups, and the dataset contains only one loan purpose and occupancy type. The data shows no clear evidence of discrimination against Asian female applicants, but it is too limited to rule it out.
